grain: one row per fiscal quarter (derived view)

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.semantics: FY26-Qn label from the configured calendar

columns.name: opportunities
columns.semantics: count of all opportunities created in the quarter

columns.name: realized_vs_list_pct
columns.semantics: sum(realized) / sum(list) x 100 over won deals

columns.name: total_realized_usd
columns.semantics: sum of realized_price over won deals

derived.enforcement: black-box rule: validator never reads summaries; never an input to validation

notes: Computed from fact rows ONLY - never authored independently. Presence checked by the linter, columns free.
